missing: A real test showing named stations actually starting a furnace blower. Also missing: the specific furnace transfer switches or inlets to buy, with current prices and installation costs, and how to handle the floating-neutral and grounding problem that some furnace control boards have.
why: No major reviewer or authority shows up. Every result is a niche calculator site, an affiliate guide or a power station maker's blog. They all give estimated runtimes and generic "hire an electrician" advice, and none has testing anyone can check. That is crowded, but it is the same mix of niche pages as in our win. A page that tests named stations on a real furnace, names the transfer switch hardware to buy with prices, and makes a direct pick would stand out.
